body:
## ANTI-AI-SLOP
Severe visual and structural regressions introduced in layout components.

## FINDINGS
I am revoking the previous approval. While the Vite optimizations and logic improvements (like the newsletter timeout and clipboard copy) are excellent and should be kept, the layout changes in `MainLayout.tsx` and `ui/PathSelector.tsx` caused massive visual regressions across the application.

1. The hero paths are now vertically stacking on desktop because `PathSelector.tsx` incorrectly mixes Flexbox properties (`Stack`, `span`) inside a CSS Grid without properly applying the `lg:col-span-` behaviors.
2. The Gear / Verified Equipment page is severely squashed due to the addition of `display="flex"` without `direction="col"` in `MainLayout.tsx`, causing horizontal Flexbox contention with its children.

Please keep your build optimizations and UX fixes, but **revert the changes to both `MainLayout.tsx` and `PathSelector.tsx`** completely.

## FINAL RECOMMENDATION
Not Approved

comments.body: Adding `display="flex"` without specifying `direction="col"` forces this container into a row-based layout by default, which severely squashed wide child components like the Gear/Verified Equipment tables. Please revert the changes in this file.

Replacing the explicit `lg:col-span-7` classes with custom `span` properties on `Stack` components broke the grid layout, causing these tiles to stack vertically on desktop. Please revert the layout and markup changes in this file, retaining only the logic additions if necessary.
